items.en: "So her plan was to get those mercs killed?"
"I had no idea you were such a humanitarian."
"Surely you can use this against her."
"So her plan is to get me killed?"
"We'll just have to find out."
"Thank you for your warning."
"She wants me to find something called the 'Threat'."
"I'm going to find out."
"I'll stay away." (lie)
"...Thanks for the warning."
"What are the first two?"

"I understand you've been funding Cornelius Elek. Giving him ideas."
"An Academician Elek said something funny- that he was being funded by Tri-Tachyon."
"Academician Elek. You funded his research. And directed it."
"He was looking into an old sensor array. It found the Onslaught Mk.I."
"Yes. I thought you might be involved."
"Because you're Tri-Tachyon's Director of 'Special Acquisitions'."
"Elek prefers his science abstract and very far away, I think."
"You prompted him. How did you know what that sensor array found?"
"Do you want to buy the Onslaught Mk.I from me?"
"I've been thinking about your offer concerning the Onslaught Mk.I."
"So was the payoff worth the investment?"
"That's a cold way to put it. He's a human being, even if he's.. him."
"My position is one million credits."
"Let's discuss this later."
"I found... many things. And an Onslaught Mk.I."
"Nope, nothing yet." (lie)
"Yes, I have an Onslaught Mk.I."
"I did find something, yes."
"I believe I found what you're looking for. And more."
"I believe I've found what you're looking for."
"I found something... hostile. In the Abyss."
"And I am eager to be paid. You got me."
Close the link
"What I found was... hostile. And Inhuman."
"No. But you already know that, don't you."
"I've found some 'interesting' specimens for you..."
"I have more 'interesting' specimens for you..."
"Why? Are you going to make me an offer for it?"
"I've considered your offer. One million credits for access and scanning of the Mk.I."
Select specimens to turn in
"I have nothing for you right now."
"I have questions about the 'specimens' I've sold you..."
"What are you going to do with the 'Threat' artifacts?"
"Does exploitating this technology not risk another AI War?"
"Do you know what the 'Threat' are, or where they came from?"
"So the 'Threat' are not alive, not intelligent?"
"The 'other' specimens- what do you intend to do with them?"
"Do you know what these 'other' specimens... are?"
"That's all I wanted to ask."
"Actually, never mind."
"Yes, I'd like to hear her proposal."

Take a shuttle to visit Director of Special Acquisitions Glamor-Rotanev
"I'm here to see Director Glamor-Rotenev."
"Isn't that nice."
Enter the office of the Director of Special Acquisitions
"I'll hear you out. What's the proposal?"
"What's the catch?"
"Directly to business, huh? No small-talk?"
"Been spying on me?"
"My favorite subject, please proceed."
"I don't see how that's your business."
"I don't think about it. Like you said, I'm practical."
"I do. I stand for the Church and the Church with me."
"I do believe, but not as does the Church. I follow Ludd's Word."
"Not as such. My interest is humanitarian."
"No, my interest is purely mercenary."
"Of course not, that's an absurd question. You should know better."
"Of course not, that's an absurd question. You should know better." (lie)
"I'm listening."
"Returns, you say. That sounds like a lot of credits."
"Exploration and new technology are of interest to me."
"You speak of meddling in things which should be left alone."
"I found some mercs in the Abyss who appeared to regret their deal with you."
"Exploration and new technology is of interest to me."
"They used rather stronger language to express the sentiment."
"They came to a poor end. I should like to avoid that for myself."
"That's one way of looking at it."
"It's dangerous out there. Very dangerous."
"No." (lie)
"Yes. I'd be a fool if I did not fear what's out there."
"Yes. Which is why I require adequate compensation."
"You haven't said exactly what I'm looking for. Salvage?"
"Is this about remnants of the AI War fleets?"
"Is it aliens?"
"Yes, but you haven't said what."
"You know a lot about what I've been doing."
"You've been prompting Elek. How'd you know where to make him look?"
"...You want to buy the Onslaught Mk.I from me?"
"But what IS it?"
"How will I know when I find it?"
"I've seen them. Ancient, automated warfleets deep in the Abyss."
"I've encountered... entities in the Abyss. Non-material, high energy. Hostile."
"I've seen ancient warfleets deep in the abyss. And... non-material hostile entities."
"I've never encountered such a thing." (lie)
"You can't detect them, can you. That's what you want."
"The Threat. They're all but invisible to you."
"One million credits."
"Tri-Tachyon's Director of Special Acquisitions can afford a mere million credits. I accept."
Make the arrangements
"I accept."
"Perhaps another time."
"So there was another expedition before me?"
"So you knew what you were asking for. Was there another expedition before me?"
"So you knew what you were asking for. Was there another expedition that succeeded?"
"So you know what it is. Was there another expedition before me?"
"So you know what it is. Was there another expedition that succeeded?"
"'Previous'? Was there another expedition before me?"
"'Previous'? Was there another expedition that succeeded before me?"
"You said 'compare'. Was there another expedition before me?"
"You said 'compare'. Was there another expedition that succeeded before me?"
"You say 'when'. Was there another expedition before me?"
"You say 'when'. Was there another expedition that succeeded before me?"
"Like the who? Was there another expedition before me?"
"Like the who? Was there another expedition that succeeded before me?"
"What are you offering to pay me. Specifically."
"I could use fuel. Lots of fuel. And tankers to carry it."
"I'm going to need supplies. And a freighter to carry them."
"I believe we've come to an arrangement."
"I'll consider your offer."
"I've considered your offer. One million credits for scan and samples from the Onslaught Mk.I. Agreed?"
"And what's your business?"
"Always pleased to meet a fan. Did you want a holo with me?"
"Excuse me, I have important business to attend to."
"Excuse me, I have important drinking to attend to."
Examine it
"Thanks. I think."
"I take it you're not Director Glamor-Rotanev?"
"What's this for?"
Pocket the card and look back to the bar
"I need to fix my reputation with the Tri-Tachyon Corporation."
"Great. Transferring credits now."
"One million, let's do it."
"Yes, yes. How much?"
"Make it happen. Transferring now."
"That seems outrageously expensive."
"I want to talk to Andrada."
"I wish to petition the glorious Supreme Executor Admiral Andrada."
"Aren't you supposed to ask how you can help me?"
"I don't know. Tell me how I serve the glory of the Lion's vision."
"Uh, thanks."
"I'll be sure to study it. Constantly."
